title: Get in touch with us
intro: Have questions about our puppies or adoption process? Fill out the form, and our team will get back to you promptly. Whether ready to adopt or just seeking info, we'd love to hear from you!

visit.title: Visit us in Downtown Dubai
visit.text: Step into our Downtown Dubai showroom and experience the joy of choosing your puppy face-to-face.

photo.alt: The apricot teddy bear puppy from our showroom, held up to say hello

success.heading: Message received!
success.body: Thank you — our team will get back to you promptly. For the quickest reply, message us on WhatsApp.

fallback.heading: Almost there!
fallback.body: We couldn't post your letter just now, so we've opened WhatsApp with it written out. Just press send and we'll reply promptly.
